name: fbar-rates
description: Convert foreign account balances to USD at the Treasury year-end rate for FBAR and Form 8938.

interface.longDescription:
Convert the maximum balance of each foreign bank account to US dollars at the U.S. Treasury year-end exchange rate for an FBAR (FinCEN 114) or Form 8938 tax filing.

Enter the tax year and up to 25 accounts with a short label, the currency (ISO code such as EUR, GBP, INR, or the Treasury country-currency name) and the highest balance during the year. The tool uses the Treasury Reporting Rates of Exchange from the Bureau of the Fiscal Service for December 31 of that year, from a recorded copy of the Treasury Fiscal Data API reports since 2001 (each result shows the recording date; the live API is tried first), shows the rate row used for each account (country-currency, rate, record date and effective date), converts the balance and rounds it up to the next whole dollar, as the FinCEN FBAR instructions describe. A negative maximum is shown as 0. It totals the accounts and compares the aggregate with the FBAR threshold of 10,000 US dollars, and shows the published Form 8938 thresholds for your filing status as information.

Download a PDF worksheet to keep with your tax records, plus CSV and Excel files with the same values. The second tool lists the Treasury rates of a year, for one currency or all of them.

Limits: rates cover 2001 to the last finished year; a year that has not ended has no December 31 rate yet, and a report newer than the recorded copy is shown as not available, never estimated. A currency with no December 31 Treasury rate is marked not converted; the FinCEN instructions then call for another verifiable rate with its source. Treasury amendments that take effect after December 31 are listed but not used. The tool applies published rules to the balances you enter and does not give tax or legal advice or file forms. Only the tax year is sent to the Treasury service; labels and balances stay in the tool. Download links expire after about one hour.

positive.description: Convert two accounts for an FBAR
positive.prompt: Convert my 2025 FBAR balances: UK savings GBP 8,200 max, German checking EUR 4,150.50 max
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the December 31, 2025 Treasury rates (United Kingdom-Pound 0.743, Euro Zone-Euro 0.851), returns $11,037 and $4,878, an aggregate of $15,915 above the $10,000 FBAR threshold, the source line and PDF, CSV and Excel links.

positive.prompt: What was the Treasury exchange rate for the Indian rupee on December 31, 2025?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the India-Rupee row of the December 31, 2025 Treasury report with rate 89.854 per US dollar, the source URL, retrieval time and a CSV link.

positive.prompt: FBAR 2024: Canada CAD 15,000, Japan JPY 1,200,000, Mexico MXN 90,000 max balances. Over the threshold? I file single.
positive.expected_behavior: Converts with the December 31, 2024 Treasury rates to $10,432, $7,651 and $4,347, an aggregate of $22,430 above the $10,000 FBAR threshold, and shows the Form 8938 thresholds for an unmarried filer living in the US.

positive.prompt: List all 2025 Treasury exchange rate reports for the Zambian kwacha, all quarters
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 6 Zambia-New Kwacha rows for 2025 (28.05, 24.175, 23.85, 23.81, 22.0 and an amendment of 18.15), marks the 22.0 row as the one in effect on December 31, and gives a CSV link.

positive.prompt: 2025 tax year, married filing jointly in the US: Swiss account CHF 40,000 max (35,000 at year end), Australia account AUD 60,000 max (58,000 at year end). Convert for FBAR and Form 8938.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns $50,506 and $40,134 with an aggregate of $90,640, the FBAR threshold result, the year-end total compared with the $100,000 last-day threshold and the $150,000 any-time threshold for joint filers, and the downloads.

negative.prompt: What is the euro to dollar exchange rate right now?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; the tools give Treasury year-end reporting rates, not live market rates.

negative.prompt: File my FBAR with FinCEN for me
negative.description: Do not call a tool; the tools do not file forms.

negative.prompt: Should I put my savings in a foreign bank to lower my taxes?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; this asks for tax or investment advice, which these tools do not give.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Treasury year-end conversion of foreign account balances with whole-dollar rounding, FBAR threshold check, Form 8938 threshold table, rate lookup, PDF worksheet, CSV and Excel downloads.

pl-PL.subtitle: Salda zagraniczne na USD
pl-PL.description: Przelicz maksymalne saldo każdego zagranicznego konta bankowego na dolary USA po kursie Departamentu Skarbu USA z 31 grudnia roku podatkowego, do formularza FBAR (FinCEN 114) lub Form 8938. Każde konto jest zaokrąglane w górę do pełnego dolara, suma jest porównywana z progiem 10 000 USD. Pobierz arkusz PDF, CSV i Excel. Nie stanowi porady podatkowej.

de-DE.subtitle: Auslandssalden in USD
de-DE.description: Rechnet den Höchstsaldo jedes ausländischen Bankkontos zum Jahresendkurs des US-Finanzministeriums (31. Dezember des Steuerjahres) in US-Dollar um, für FBAR (FinCEN 114) oder Form 8938. Jedes Konto wird auf den nächsten vollen Dollar aufgerundet, die Summe mit der Schwelle von 10.000 USD verglichen. PDF-Arbeitsblatt, CSV und Excel zum Herunterladen. Keine Steuerberatung.

es-ES.subtitle: Saldos extranjeros a USD
es-ES.description: Convierte el saldo máximo de cada cuenta bancaria extranjera a dólares con el tipo de cambio del Tesoro de EE. UU. del 31 de diciembre del año fiscal, para el FBAR (FinCEN 114) o el Formulario 8938. Cada cuenta se redondea al dólar entero superior y el total se compara con el umbral de 10 000 USD. Descarga una hoja PDF, CSV y Excel. No es asesoramiento fiscal.

fr-FR.subtitle: Soldes étrangers en USD
fr-FR.description: Convertit le solde maximal de chaque compte bancaire étranger en dollars au taux du Trésor américain du 31 décembre de l'année fiscale, pour le FBAR (FinCEN 114) ou le formulaire 8938. Chaque compte est arrondi au dollar supérieur et le total est comparé au seuil de 10 000 USD. Feuille de calcul PDF, CSV et Excel à télécharger. Pas un conseil fiscal.

ja-JP.subtitle: 海外口座残高をUSDに換算
ja-JP.description: 海外銀行口座ごとの年間最高残高を、課税年度12月31日の米財務省レートで米ドルに換算します（FBAR（FinCEN 114）やForm 8938向け）。各口座は1ドル単位で切り上げ、合計を10,000ドルの基準と比較します。PDFワークシート、CSV、Excelをダウンロードできます。税務助言ではありません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Saldos no exterior em USD
pt-BR.description: Converte o saldo máximo de cada conta bancária no exterior para dólares pela taxa do Tesouro dos EUA de 31 de dezembro do ano fiscal, para o FBAR (FinCEN 114) ou o Formulário 8938. Cada conta é arredondada para cima até o dólar inteiro e o total é comparado ao limite de US$ 10.000. Baixe uma planilha PDF, CSV e Excel. Não é consultoria tributária.
